body: Planning record — 2026-10-09. Requested outcome: an extremely detailed implementation plan saved in Dark Mechanicus, grounded in the local FWGC++ code and current Bannerlord interfaces. Confirmed scope: generation inside New Campaign, generated geography and campaign content, War Sails naval travel. Planning acceptance: A1 local source/build/export audit; A2 current primary-source engine evidence and explicit runtime feasibility blockers; A3 sized tickets with owned paths, contracts, dependencies, targeted checks and per-sprint acceptance; A4 live API validation and saved readback. Root owns plan/storage writes. Workers: fwg_audit source/compiler research; bannerlord_research official runtime/API research; darkmechanicus_audit connector and adversarial review. No implementation run started. The generator has a stale existing executable; game and kit downloads are incomplete at inspection. Mandatory early gate: runtime generation/navigation/object-registration/save-load in the shipping client. Final plan must never equate an external editor bake, preselected map catalogue, or static replacement map with the requested in-game procedural system.
